# Zenith Automations

> HighLevel (GoHighLevel) setup, automation and AI agency. We build and run the systems
> that capture, answer and book leads: CRM and pipelines, workflows, voice and chat AI,
> A2P 10DLC, websites and funnels, paid ads, social media, Google Business Profile and
> membership sites — for businesses directly and white-label for agencies.

Contact: anna@zenith-automations.com
Site: https://zenith-automations.com/

## What we do

- HighLevel setup and migration — domain, email and phone connection, A2P 10DLC
  registration, pipelines, calendars, forms and the follow-up workflows behind them.
- Custom HighLevel snapshots — a complete reusable sub-account build per industry.
- AI voice agents — receptionists that answer calls the team misses and book into the calendar.
- Conversation AI — SMS, web chat, Instagram and Facebook DM agents that reply in seconds.
- Missed-call text-back and speed-to-lead automation.
- Websites, landing pages and funnels.
- Paid ads (Meta and Google), social media management, Google Business Profile.
- Memberships, online courses and communities.
- White-label fulfilment for HighLevel agencies, built inside your account under your brand.

## Industries

Med spa and aesthetics, dental, medical equipment rental, real estate, HVAC, roofing,
home services, gyms and fitness, coaching and consulting, schools and training providers.

## Common questions

HighLevel setup order: connect domain, email sending and phone number, register A2P 10DLC,
build pipeline and calendars, build follow-up workflows, then layer AI agents and reporting.
Skipping the messaging and domain plumbing is the most common reason a HighLevel account
is never used.

A2P 10DLC approval: brand registration is usually quick; campaign review takes days to a
few weeks. Texts do not deliver reliably until it clears.

Snapshots: a saved copy of a whole sub-account build that loads into a new sub-account in
minutes, so every client starts from a proven setup.

Pricing: fixed-scope projects rather than hourly billing. Scope is quoted against a stated budget.
